text.autoconfig.simplepads.option.padTun:
Multiplies the launch strength of launchpads
(1.5 plus 0.8 per wind charge). 0.5 = half as
high, 2 = twice as strong. Default: 1.0.
Range: 0–2.0.

A player standing on a potion pad gets 25 %,
50 % and then 100 % of the effect duration in
three steps; this is the length of one step
in ticks. Default: 20 (1 s, full after 3 s).
Range: 1–1200.

After a full charge the potion pad cools down
for this many times the granted effect
duration, times the effect's own multiplier
(Healing and Harming 2, Night Vision 0.5, see
docs/TRANK-PADS.md). 0 = no cooldown.
Default: 2.0. Range: 0–10.0.

How long a player has to stand still on a
spawn teleporter I before it teleports, in
ticks (20 = 1 s). Default: 1000 (50 s).
Range: 1–12000.

The same for spawn teleporter II. Default:
400 (20 s). Range: 1–12000.

The same for the Enderite spawn teleporter
III (the final easter stage waits half as
long). Default: 100 (5 s). Range: 1–12000.

jei.simplepads.info.elytra_pad: Hands a Spawn Elytra to players with an empty chest slot in its area and recharges it. Area per tier: 5x5, 32x32 and 128x128 blocks (height 5, 32 and 192); from tier III (Enderite) on, boosts recharge in the whole area. Tier I is smithed from a Diamond Core (in the template slot), a diamond pressure plate and an elytra.
jei.simplepads.info.flypad: Grants creative flight inside its area and takes it back outside. Three enderite tiers: 4x4x8, 8x8x16 and 16x16x32 blocks; leaving the area while flying gives 10 s of Slow Falling. Tier I is crafted (shapeless) from an Enderite Core, an Enderite Pressure Plate, a Shulker Head and an elytra enchanted with Mending - a plain elytra does not fit.
jei.simplepads.info.spawn_teleporter: Stand still on it to travel home: to your own respawn point (bed or respawn anchor, no charge used), or to the spawn target (set by operators, otherwise the world spawn) if you have none. With a redstone signal it always takes you to the spawn target / world spawn instead - it sparkles white instead of purple and sounds like a bell and a beacon instead of a respawn anchor. Waiting time: 50 s on tier I, 20 s on Netherite II, 5 s on Enderite III. Tier I is smithed from a Gold Core (in the template slot), a light weighted pressure plate and an Enderman Head. The sound builds up over the waiting time (quarters are marked); moving cancels it. Any redstone signal strength change immediately resets the countdown, including short pulses.
jei.simplepads.info.chunk_loader: Keeps chunks loaded: tier I its own chunk, Netherite (II) also the four chunks sharing an edge with it (5 chunks), Enderite (III) the 3x3 chunks around it. Releases only the chunks it forced itself. Tier I is smithed from a Copper Core (in the template slot), a copper pressure plate and the head of a trial chamber mob (zombie, husk, skeleton, stray, bogged, spider, cave spider, slime, silverfish or breeze).
jei.simplepads.info.launchpad: Right-click with wind charges to charge it, sneak + right-click loads all charges in your hand; the higher the sound, the fuller it is. Holds 4 (I), 8 (Netherite II) or 16 (Enderite III); stand on it for 3 s to be launched. Enderite: no fall damage until the next landing. Tier I is smithed from an Iron Core (in the template slot), a heavy weighted pressure plate and the head of a trial chamber mob (zombie, husk, skeleton, stray, bogged, spider, cave spider, slime, silverfish or breeze).
jei.simplepads.info.potion_pad: Throw a splash or lingering potion onto the pad to store its effects (a new potion replaces the old one, a water splash potion wipes it); the potion stays in the pad until you break it. Stand on it for 3 seconds: after 1 s you have 25 %, after 2 s 50 % and after 3 s the full duration - 45 s (I), 90 s (Reinforced II) or 180 s (Infused III), but never longer than the potion itself lasts and never above the level a vanilla potion brews. Instant effects (Healing, Harming) apply once, at the 3 s mark. Beneficial effects reach everyone on the pad; harmful ones (Poison, Harming, Slowness, Levitation ...) and Glowing only the player who placed it; omens, Saturation, Absorption and other effects no potion carries are never given; mobs get nothing. The full application puts the pad on cooldown for 1.5 times the granted duration (Healing and Harming 135 s, Regeneration, Resistance and Invisibility 1.5 times, Night Vision half); Healing, Harming and Regeneration also keep that player from getting them from any pad for 60 s. Stepping off early keeps what you got and starts no cooldown. The cooldown only runs while the pad is placed: broken, it keeps the remaining time, its potion and its easter stage. Stacks to 1.
jei.simplepads.info.diamond_pressure_pla: Only players press it; mobs and items do not.
jei.simplepads.info.netherite_pressure_p: With a barrel below it, only players carrying one of the barrel's items press it.
jei.simplepads.info.enderite_pressure_pl: Owner-locked: the owner always presses it; with a barrel below also players named on a renamed name tag in it or carrying one of its items.
jei.simplepads.info.copper_pressure_plat: Powers only after a player has stood on it for 1-4 s, longer the more oxidized it is, and releases just as long after the player has stepped off. An axe scrapes one stage off; honeycomb waxes it (waxed plates stop oxidizing), an axe scrapes the wax off again.
jei.simplepads.info.spawn_elytra: Temporary elytra from the spawn area or an Elytra Pad; flight timer, boosts with jump while gliding.
